definitions.explanation: The act of cooking rice. Most commonly encountered in the compound {炊飯器|すいはんき} (rice cooker).

examples.japanese: {炊飯器|すいはんき}でご{飯|はん}を{炊|た}く。
examples.english: To cook rice in a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{炊飯器|すいはんき}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new rice cooker.

examples.japanese: この{炊飯器|すいはんき}は{予約|よやく}{炊飯|すいはん}{機能|きのう}がついているので、{朝|あさ}にはご{飯|はん}が{炊|た}けている。
examples.english: This rice cooker has a timed cooking function, so the rice is ready in the morning.

notes:
{炊飯|すいはん} combines {炊|すい} (to cook rice) + {飯|はん} (cooked rice). Almost always encountered in the compound {炊飯器|すいはんき} (rice cooker). The word {炊飯|すいはん} alone is uncommon in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炊飯器|すいはんき}: rice cooker
- {炊飯|すいはん}{機能|きのう}: rice cooking function
- {炊飯|すいはん}{予約|よやく}: timed rice cooking
- {炊飯|すいはん}{量|りょう}: amount of rice to cook

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {炊飯器|すいはんき} is one of the most essential kitchen appliances in Japan. Modern rice cookers have advanced features like {予約|よやく}{炊飯|すいはん} (timer cooking) and multiple settings for different rice types.

RELATED TERMS:
- ご{飯|はん}: cooked rice / meal
- {炊|た}く: to cook (rice)
- {米|こめ}: uncooked rice
